[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Kullen Velerinden''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who commanded the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Tasariq]]. Born on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], Velerinden was a petty criminal until he tried to beat up an off-duty Imperial Army [[Major/Legends|major]]. The major beat the young man and gave him a choice; take his chances in Elrood's legal system, or join the Imperial Army. Velerinden chose the latter.<ref name="J15" />

Velerinden excelled in the Army, impressing his [[Drill sergeant/Legends|drill sergeants]] and being recommended for officer training at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Academy]]. He rose through the ranks, and demonstrated his skills as an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] commander. However, Velerinden's nature as a criminal did not disappear, and he began making thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the side through a variety of illegal activities, including selling supplies to the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. A love of high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] but little talent for the game ensured he had little to show for his schemes.<ref name="J15" />

On the verge of being promoted to major, another officer uncovered Velerinden's illegal ventures and threatened to expose him. Velerinden used his connections to destroy the other officer's career, but at a cost. Rather than a promotion, Velerinden was posted to Tasariq, and given command of the garrison there. His authority was second only to the [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. On Tasariq, Velerinden established himself as a central figure in the underworld and finally began making more money than he lost at the sabacc table.<ref name="J15" />
